title: Superfiltering: Weak-to-Strong Data Filtering for Fast Instruction-Tuning
authors_zh: Ming Li, Yong Zhang, Shwai He, Zhitao Li, Hongyu Zhao, Jianzong Wang, Ning Cheng, Tianyi Zhou
paper_type_zh: 开放指令数据集与构造方法研究
best_for_zh: 在筛选与训练预算有限时挑选小规模高效指令子集
one_line: Superfiltering releases scored Alpaca-family records and tiny subsets selected by GPT-2 instruction-following difficulty.
Superfiltering 发布带 GPT-2 指令跟随难度分数的 Alpaca 系列记录及其小比例筛选子集。
why: using a weak language model's conditional-loss ratio as a data-utility ranking signal
inclusion_reason: Superfiltering scored instruction data is a public Track 01 training object: instruction, optional input, output, GPT-2 instruction-following difficulty score, and selection membership; it is consumed by small-subset instruction SFT.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Instruction filtering with a strong model can cost nearly as much as training, while random or surface-level selection keeps redundant and low-utility examples.

The paper's decision boundary is the released Superfiltering scored instruction data training object, not a model-only report or an evaluation-only benchmark. One record contains instruction, optional input, output, GPT-2 instruction-following difficulty score, and selection membership; its selection boundary is low instruction-following difficulty scores rank records before fixed-percentage selection, and the records are consumed by small-subset instruction SFT.

L4 facts: the official ACL 2024 Main page, public records at https://github.com/tianyi-lab/Superfiltering/tree/main/data, release scale and terms were checked on 2026-07-27. The paper is included because its central contribution directly constructs or curates serialized post-training targets.

用强模型筛选指令的成本可能接近训练本身，而随机或表面规则又会保留冗余、低效样本。

该方法用 GPT-2 的条件损失比估计回答对指令的依赖程度，低成本排序全量数据，并公开 5% 与 2% 的筛选子集。 该方法直接产出 Superfiltering scored instruction data。本卡的决策边界是可下载训练记录，而不是只有模型的报告或只用于评测的基准；单条记录包含 指令、可选输入、回答、GPT-2 指令跟随难度分数和子集成员标记。

L4 事实：已于 2026-07-27 核验 ACL 2024 Main 官方页面、https://github.com/tianyi-lab/Superfiltering/tree/main/data 的实际公开记录、规模和条款。收录理由是论文中心贡献直接构造或筛选可序列化的后训练目标。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Superfiltering uses GPT-2 loss ratios to score how much each response depends on its instruction, ranks the full pool cheaply, and publishes the scored records together with 5 percent and 2 percent subsets. The closest comparison is random selection and strong-LLM quality scoring over the full instruction pool; unlike that neighbor, the primary object here is Superfiltering scored instruction data and the feedback boundary is low instruction-following difficulty scores rank records before fixed-percentage selection, which makes this an instruction/demonstration data paper rather than a model-architecture-only entry.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source the task substrate. Input: public Alpaca and Alpaca-GPT4 instruction pools. Operation: Normalize source identifiers, media or task inputs, and target fields into the release schema. Output and transition: Candidate records containing instruction, optional input, output, GPT-2 instruction-following difficulty score, and selection membership advance to target construction. Check / stop rule: Reject missing inputs, targets, or source provenance.

Step 2 - Write or transform the target. Input: The normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: a small GPT-2 model computes instruction-following difficulty from conditional loss produces or supplies the target while preserving fields needed for audit. Output and transition: A serialized instruction, demonstration, caption, rationale, or response advances to verification. Check / stop rule: A target that cannot be tied back to its input or source annotation is not retained.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated or transformed candidates. Operation: Apply low instruction-following difficulty scores rank records before fixed-percentage selection; deduplicate and assign release splits where documented. Output and transition: Passing records form scored Alpaca and Alpaca-GPT4 pools with public 5 percent and 2 percent selected subsets stored as JSON instruction-input-output records with filtering scores and selected splits and advance to training use. Check / stop rule: Keep only records that pass the stated correctness, grounding, format, or selection contract.

Step 4 - Consume the data. Input: The released records and the paper's chosen base model. Operation: Use them for small-subset instruction SFT and compare against random selection and strong-LLM quality scoring over the full instruction pool. Output and transition: A trained checkpoint and controlled evidence about the data intervention become the final evaluated artifacts. Check / stop rule: Judge both target-task quality and regression on general capabilities; no universal early-stopping threshold is disclosed.

Reproducibility requires pinning source revisions, the public manifest, transformation prompts, teacher version, filters, split, base checkpoint, and evaluation harness. The complete generation budget is not disclosed.

步骤 1——取得任务底材。 输入：论文核验过的公开任务、媒体、文档或已有指令来源。 操作：统一来源编号、输入和目标字段，并保留追踪信息。 输出及流转：候选记录进入目标构造阶段。 检查与停止规则：缺少输入、目标或来源信息的记录直接删除。

步骤 2——撰写或转换目标。 输入：规范化候选及其来源证据。 操作：该方法用 GPT-2 的条件损失比估计回答对指令的依赖程度，低成本排序全量数据，并公开 5% 与 2% 的筛选子集。 输出及流转：得到包含 指令、可选输入、回答、GPT-2 指令跟随难度分数和子集成员标记 的结构化记录，并进入验证阶段。 检查与停止规则：不能回溯到输入、来源标注或生成轮次的目标不保留。

步骤 3——验证并打包。 输入：生成或转换后的候选记录。 操作：按论文披露的正确性、执行结果、视觉落地、格式或质量信号筛选，并在有说明时去重和划分数据。 输出及流转：通过检查的 带分数的 Alpaca 与 Alpaca-GPT4 数据池，以及公开的 5% 和 2% 子集 以 包含分数和筛选划分的 JSON 记录 发布，随后进入训练。 检查与停止规则：只有满足论文接受契约且必需字段完整的记录进入发布集。

步骤 4——消费数据。 输入：公开记录与论文采用的基础模型。 操作：按论文配方完成指令微调、蒸馏或相应后训练，并与最近基线比较。 输出及流转：训练后的检查点和数据干预的受控证据成为最终评估产物。 检查与停止规则：同时检查目标任务质量和通用能力回退；论文未披露统一早停阈值时不得自行补写。

复现时需固定来源修订版、公开清单、转换提示、教师版本、过滤器、切分、基础检查点和评测工具。完整端到端生成预算若未披露，应保留为未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across matched instruction-tuning settings, the top 5 percent selected by GPT-2 outperforms training on the complete baseline pool on the reported evaluation suite, while filtering is roughly 20 times faster than strong-model scoring.

Impact cross-check: OpenAlex reported 20 citations on 2026-07-27, and the official dataset exposes actual reusable records rather than only weights or examples. The count is an impact signal, not a Google Scholar citation line and not evidence that every record is correct.

在匹配的指令微调设置下，GPT-2 选出的前 5% 数据在论文评测上超过使用完整基线池的模型，并且筛选速度约快 20 倍。结论支持该数据池上的弱模型排序，不代表所有领域都能安全只留 5%。

影响力交叉检查：OpenAlex 在 2026-07-27 报告 20 次引用，官方数据集也公开了可复用实际记录，而不是只有权重或样例。该数字只作为影响信号，不是 Google Scholar 引用数，也不能证明每条记录都正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work baseline: random selection and strong-LLM quality scoring over the full instruction pool. The actual change is using a weak language model's conditional-loss ratio as a data-utility ranking signal. This is a direction signal because it changes the serialized data object and its selection contract, not merely the backbone. The inherited model family, source tasks, autoregressive loss, and common benchmarks are not new. Before reuse, inspect the score may reward easy instruction-output lexical dependence and discard rare capabilities.
相对最近的共同做法，用弱语言模型的条件损失比作为指令记录效用排序信号。 这改变了可审计的数据对象或选择决策，而不只是更换骨干模型。继承的模型家族、自回归训练目标和常用评测并不新；复用前还要检查 分数可能偏爱简单的指令回答词面关联并丢弃稀有能力。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. A low difficulty score can favor stylistic dependence rather than factual quality
  2. results center on Alpaca-family pools
  3. fixed top-percent selection can reduce domain and language coverage.

1. 低难度分数可能只反映词面依赖，而非事实质量。
  2. 实验主要围绕 Alpaca 系列数据池。
  3. 固定比例取前项会削弱稀有领域和语言覆盖。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For selecting a small instruction subset when scoring and training budgets are limited, use the official manifest and schema to build a controlled SFT mixture. The output should be a versioned dataset and a fixed-backbone comparison; success requires the paper's task metrics plus an audit of the score may reward easy instruction-output lexical dependence and discard rare capabilities.
  • For data auditing, sample records across sources and reproduce the stated selection contract: low instruction-following difficulty scores rank records before fixed-percentage selection. Do not reuse the release when its licensing or source provenance cannot be preserved.

• 若要在筛选与训练预算有限时挑选小规模高效指令子集，可复用官方清单、记录结构和论文披露的筛选配方。输出应是带版本的数据集与固定骨干对照；成功标准除论文指标外，还要审计 分数可能偏爱简单的指令回答词面关联并丢弃稀有能力。
  • 数据审计者应跨来源抽样，复查必需字段、接受规则和许可。若无法保留来源信息或执行相同检查，就不应直接复用。
